title: Momiji no Yūbe
subtitle: Warm lantern light beneath the torii
description: Pass beneath a glowing torii as paper lanterns sway overhead and maple leaves drift through the autumn dark. Your portrait is bathed in the amber warmth of a quiet Kyoto evening.

promptTemplate.borderStyle: Ornate translucent washi-paper and vermilion lacquer frame inspired by a torii gate threshold. Slender vermilion lacquered pillars with amber rim-light along extreme left and right edges, upswept kasagi lintel arcing across the top without crossing the guest's face, woven shimenawa rope swag with hanging white zigzag shide streamers, frosted glassmorphism haze bleeding inward at 20 percent opacity, glowing chōchin paper lanterns in amber, ember orange, and muted gold hanging from upper corners on delicate cords, drifting hand-painted maple leaves in crimson, burnt orange, and antique gold along lower border and outer edges, thin gold-leaf filigree accents on pillar bases and lantern caps. Center 70 percent fully transparent and unobstructed, three-dimensional architectural depth, soft inner shadow, never covering face, hair, or torso.
promptTemplate.topTitleStyle: Rendered in an exquisite hand-brushed Mincho-style serif with subtle ink-bleed edges, filled with warm antique gold leaf and softly embossed into the kasagi lintel beam, faint amber backlight glow, delicate red seal-stamp accents at first and last letters, generous letter-spacing, shallow engraved shadow carved into the frame's architecture.
promptTemplate.subtitleStyle: Elegantly etched in a smaller, minimalist gold serif directly below the top title, centered on the nuki beam, thin hairline strokes, slightly weathered gold-leaf patina, faint inner glow, subtle washi-paper texture, en dash rendered as a small stylized maple leaf silhouette.
promptTemplate.bottomTitleStyle: Displayed in bold, luminous calligraphy anchored within a lower crest shaped like a rounded lacquered plaque, framed by a slim shimenawa rope detail and two small glowing lantern icons on either side, letters rendered in deep vermilion lacquer with a rich gold-leaf outline, softly backlit with warm amber bloom as a physical illuminated emblem at the base of the torii.
promptTemplate.typoStyle: All typography is softly backlit with a warm amber glow and seamlessly integrated into the sweeping torii architecture — the top title carved into the kasagi lintel, the years etched on the nuki beam, and the anniversary badge anchored in a lacquered lower crest — so no text floats as a flat overlay.
